decisions.reason: A green startup accelerator is peripheral to a machinery firm, and with no website updates since 2023 it is a likely candidate to cut so resources can go to the core WASTX recycling systems.
The bio-based bitumen binder remains a flagship of the firm's climate positioning, but it is far from its core plastic and oil recycling technology and faces long adoption cycles.
The infectious waste plant is co-developed with ERMAFA, close to the core WASTX line, and serves regulated healthcare demand, which justifies continued investment.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the modular WASTX portfolio directly, works as a pretreatment stage, and fits the decentralized strategy.
